## Appearance

Cedric initially features large, extremely dark blue eyes and delicate, exquisite refinement. Though once small with a halo of chestnut brown curls, by age sixteen his hair is cut short, and he eventually grows into an impressive six-foot-tall man.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0029), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P26](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0026), [v3 ch.Revelation P2](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0002), +1 more_

## Personality

Cedric Stanhope is an intelligent and imaginative young boy with a brilliant mind, often noted as being an exceptionally unusual child. Known for his gentlemanly and clean habits, he also demonstrates a remarkable manliness and capability when participating in games. His main desire is to have a mother.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P32](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0032), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P52](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0052), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P28](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0028), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P10](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0010), +1 more_

## History

Cedric Stanhope moved from the United States to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) to live with his grandmother down near the beach, where he initially lacked companions. Upon attending school, he formed an immediate warm connection with his teacher, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), becoming her favorite student. He enjoyed sharing his imaginative tales with her, writing to her about fantastical sea companions and adventures. Cedric lost his mother, a topic he discussed with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) during a trip to the cemetery and when she visited his home for tea. Despite his initial lack of friends, Cedric grew close with others in the community, accompanying [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage), where he comforted Miss Rosalind [Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) as she opened up to him about her dream-boy. Shortly after the end of the school term, Cedric's father, [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md), arrived unexpectedly, which ultimately led to Stephen's marriage to [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), making her Cedric's mother. Cedric later attended [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh's orchard wedding at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). Knowing his creative talents, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) later wished he could write a book based on the adventuring life log of Captain Saul.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P11](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0011), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P20](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0020), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), +43 more_

## Quotes

> "Mrs. Sowerby, father made a pretty good job of picking out my first mother and I could trust him to pick out just as good a one the second time."
>
> — Cedric Stanhope — [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P22](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0022)

> "you can’t imagine what took place! Something truly wonderful. Father has arrived . . . only imagine that! Father has arrived! Step right inside. Father, this is my lovely teacher. You understand, father."
>
> — Cedric Stanhope — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021)

> "It is possible that you are well-known as well, Teacher. Over these past three years, I have come across much of what you have done."
>
> — Cedric Stanhope — [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P35](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0035)

> "and I returned so I could offer them to you since I believed you were a lady who would appreciate them, and also because . . ."
>
> — Cedric Stanhope — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)

> "Mary Joe, do you know what I think? I think the evening star is a lighthouse on the land where the fairies dwell."
>
> — Cedric Stanhope — [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P28](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0028)

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cedric-stanhope--nell-harcourt.md)

### [Nora](../character/nora.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cedric-stanhope--nora.md)

[Nora](../character/nora.md) is an imaginary rock person created by Cedric as a whimsical shoreline companion. Cedric includes [Nora](../character/nora.md) in his imaginative letters, describing creative adventures where they sail into the moon and travel into the sunset together.

### [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cedric-stanhope--harcourt.md)

[Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md) served as Cedric's school instructor in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley). The two established a warm connection from Nell's very first day teaching, with Cedric quickly becoming her favorite student. Cedric frequently brightened her day by bringing her wild orchids, writing imaginative letters, and joining her on outings to pick strawberries and visit friends.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P11](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0011), +18 more_
